description: Mark a voucher as used at the merchant. Send one of voucher_code (alias code) or voucher_id (anyOf). If neither is sent the tool returns error_code missing_identifier and an example. A voucher used before returns error_code voucher_already_used (do not retry).

voucher_code.description: Voucher code (LOYAL-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). Use this OR voucher_id.

voucher_id.description: Voucher UUID. Use this OR voucher_code.

name: use_voucher
title: Use Voucher
